features.name: Visitor chat
features.description: The ready chat widget and the visitor API for your own chat screens, with window.SSChat.

features.name: Guest chat
features.description: Visitors chat without signing in, up to the guest message limit, remembered on their device.

features.name: Signed-in chat
features.description: Visitors signed in with Accounts chat as themselves; a guest chat moves to the account on sign-in.

features.name: AI replies
features.description: The AI answers visitors with your own AI provider key (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini or any OpenAI-compatible service).

features.name: Backup AI provider
features.description: When the main AI provider fails, the backup provider answers.

features.name: AI instructions
features.description: Your own instructions for the AI (up to 12,000 characters), on top of the built-in neutral ones.

features.name: AI token caps
features.description: Daily and monthly caps on the AI tokens a website uses; at a cap the AI stops until the window resets.

features.name: AI cost alerts
features.description: One alert a month to your staff when the AI tokens cross a share of the monthly cap.

features.name: Language lock
features.description: The AI answers in the visitor’s language, from the languages you allow.

features.name: Knowledge base
features.description: FAQ entries and articles the AI answers from.

features.name: Website pages as knowledge
features.description: Pages of your website the AI answers from, fetched when added and with Fetch again.

features.name: Knowledge editor
features.description: The knowledge editor widget for your admin.

features.name: Custom webhook tools
features.description: Tools the AI can call on your own server, signed with your tool signing secret.

features.name: Book-a-slot tool
features.description: The AI offers free time slots and books one through your own booking endpoint.

features.name: Proactive idle nudge
features.description: A nudge beside the launcher after the visitor has been idle for a while.

features.name: Proactive page rules
features.description: A message on matching pages after a delay.

features.name: Proactive exit intent
features.description: A message when the pointer leaves the top of the window (desktop only).

features.name: Lead capture and flows
features.description: Collects contact details as leads, and runs short scripted flows started by a page or a keyword.

features.name: Custom fields
features.description: Your own fields on conversations and leads.

features.name: Attachments
features.description: Images and PDFs in the chat, stored in your own storage.

features.name: Typing indicator and read receipts
features.description: Visitors see typing while the AI prepares a reply; both sides see Seen.

features.name: Ratings
features.description: Visitors rate the chat, with an optional comment.

features.name: Transcripts by e-mail
features.description: Visitors and staff e-mail a copy of a chat, through Notifications.

features.name: Inbox
features.description: The inbox widget where your staff read and answer conversations.

features.name: Human handoff
features.description: Hands a conversation to a person: the AI stops and your staff take over, with office hours.

features.name: Assignment
features.description: Assign conversations to members of your staff.

features.name: Staff presence, max concurrent chats and queue position
features.description: Online, Away or Offline, a limit of open chats per person, and the visitor’s place in the queue.

features.name: Internal notes
features.description: Notes on a conversation that only your staff see.

features.name: Saved replies
features.description: Replies your staff save and reuse.

features.name: Conversation context panel
features.description: Who the visitor is, where the chat started and their earlier conversations, beside the conversation.

features.name: AI conversation summary
features.description: A short AI summary when a conversation is handed to a person, and on demand.

features.name: Staff alerts
features.description: E-mails your staff about new messages and handoffs, through Notifications.

features.name: Moderation
features.description: Hides personal data, filters leaks from AI answers, applies a link policy and your blocked terms.

features.name: Reports
features.description: The reports widget: conversations, AI and staff answers, reply times, ratings, leads and AI tokens.

permissions.name: See conversations and set your own presence
Status, assignment, notes, saved replies, custom field values and max chats
